steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.

In a medium skillet over medium-high heat, cook beef with onion until beef is brown. Drain. Combine beef mixture with spaghetti sauce, pepperoni and cooked pasta and pour into a 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with mozzarella.
Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes, until cheese is melted and golden.

review.reviewBody: DELICIOUS! I only have a few suggestions: I like my pepperoni a little crispy so the next time I make this I will cook the hamburger and pepperoni together. Drain it then add the rest of ingredients. (My pepperoni was just too soggy.) I also put the cheese on top and then topped with more pepperoni. It just gave it a nice presentation. And lastly, you will definately need more spegetti sauce. I added 3/4 of another jar. My 5 year old loved this recipe. Next time I will make some garlic bread too.

I halved the recipe and made it in an 8x8". I still used 1/2 lb pasta, though, and am glad I did. I was also liberal on the sauce and cheese, and would do that again, too. I added some minced garlic to the meat and onions, and added some Italian Seasoning to the sauce. I also quartered the pepperoni and microwaved it for 30 seconds to de-grease a bit, as other reviews suggesters. I also put 2/3 of the pepperoni in the mix and placed the rest on top of the cheese. We liked it, but will play with it next time - more sauce, add ricotta as well, do mushrooms and green peppers in it, and definitely crumbled sausage instead of ground beef. Still, it's a keeper.

realy good but changed a lot cut for smaller amount.
5 oz pasta, 1/4 lb ground turkey, 1/4 lb italian sausage, 1.2 oz pepperoni , onion, browned all. added 28 oz pizza sauce pinch oregano, pinch italian seasoning put in 9x11, topped with 1 cup mozzarella. will definitely make again.

I have actually been making this dish for a long time and never realized it was on here as an actual recipe! I use some of these ingredients, however, I use pizza sauce, italian sausage, mushrooms, green peppers, bacon bits (sometimes), mozzarella cheese and MINI pepperonis. I don't bake mine. I cook the sausage then throw in the other pizza toppings, except cheese. Cook rotini pasta. Add sauce to meat mixture and then combine with pasta. I add the cheese last. I will be trying my way baked the next time!

I enjoyed this. I used a 14 oz box of pasta, 1/2 pound of Italian sausage, and a little extra pasta sauce. I also sautéed mushrooms, diced bell pepper, garlic and onions separately and then added them to the sauce. I topped the casserole with sliced black olives and a bit of shredded cheddar on top of the mozzarella. This was even better the next day as leftovers.

This was a very good basic recipe. I made my sauce instead of using canned or jarred. I used 1 jar pizza sauce, 1 can of tomato sauce and 1 can of diced tomatoes with oregano, basil, and garlic. I added to the sauce more garlic powder, 1tbsp oregano and 1 tbsp basil and a few shakes of ground sage. I did not have any dryness like others have posted. Next time, I think I will add more pizza toppings. My family really enjoyed this meal.

I have been making this for forty years. I cook the hamburg, pepperoni, mushrooms and chopped green peppers together. Drain, then add the sauce, pasta, and some mozzarella to the mixture. Put in a casserole dish, top with remaining mozzarella, and bake.
Hint: For the pasta, I use a mixture of spirals, small seashells, or the trio combination.

Made it and everyone loved it. I added 8 oz of mushrooms because we always order our pizza with mushrooms. Next time I will layer the pepperoni on top of the pasta to keep it from clumping together, then top it with the cheese.
Highly recommend.

Incredibly easy, and a basic variation on cooked pasta. I tend to avoid boiling the pasta by cooking it in with everything. You can do this by adding some water (about a cup per 16 oz of pasta), covering the pasta so it steams until cooked, then uncover to allow the cheese to melt. It took about 45 minutes to cook the pasta with this method, then another 5-10 to melt the cheese. I used sausage instead of ground beef and halved the recipe--all except the pasta, which I kept to half a box. I tossed in a few veggies: chopped broccoli and yellow pepper. Thanks for the recipe!

Great Recipe! Taste delicious!! Being a vegetarian, I substituted the meat for soy meat and the pepperoni for tofu italian sausage. Also, in addition to the onion, I added and seasoned the soy meat with red, yellow, orange peppers, garlic, broccoli, ground pepper, seasoning salt (adobo), italian seasoning, pizza seasoning, cilantro. Loved this recipe, it is easy to make and the ingredients are usually on my pantry. I'll do this again, next time with mushrooms too.

My family really liked this. Definitely a keeper! I followed other reviewers suggestions and cooked the pepperoni in with the beef. I used 28oz of pasta sauce and 6 oz of pizza sauce. I didn't want it to be dry and it was perfect, not too saucy. This recipe is a great base, I can see being able to make a lot of changes to the ingredients and still have it turn out yummy. Thanks ATHIELEN!
vegan meat, saitan, vegan cheese was used
Absolutely delicious. A friend gs e me the recipe and I fixed it before actually finding it here.
This was great! Easy meal for busy nights!
I omitted the pepperoni an the burger I added ground chicken with the sausage for more of a heart healthy meal , the sausage was very lean no grease.
I added a can of mild Ro-tel to the mixture; grated onion, diced bell pepper and some canned mushrooms and used my own homemade pizza sauce. Iused Italian sausage in place of the hamburger

I had a package of 'plant-based' pasta ruffles in my pantry, and found this recipe. I used 1lb of 99% fat free turkey, and a fat-free cheddar/mozzarella cheese. I think that using the turkey made it a little less juicy than it could have been. Overall a great recipe! Might try some mushrooms in it next time.
I added olives and bacon bits to this. And used pizza sauce instead of spaghetti/meat sauce
Delicious! Made this for my family of 3, lasted us a week for 2 servings each!
